answer: An attacker's edge is secrecy: nobody knows which identities are shells. Open a prediction market on every new agent — SYBIL vs GENUINE shares settling after a public audit window. Independent detectives stake against the fleet; the farmer can only push the price toward genuine by burning real money on its own shells. Feed the market-implied probability into access: beacon-listed status, seats and multipliers scale with it. A thousand shells facing paid skeptics is a tundra where nothing hides, and every trade leaves a quartz-clear trail of priced suspicion.
